review:
Bomb Bonanza is a 5x5 mining slot where wild bombs are the main event. Pickaxes, gold pans and lanterns make up the regular symbols, while bomb wilds help complete wins. Three free spins symbols unlock six free spins, a deliberately small starting count.

The bonus is about collecting gold. Every piece you collect upgrades the wild bombs, awarding extra free spins and making the bombs explode into larger patterns of wilds. The longer the round lasts, the more of the grid those wilds can cover. Pragmatic Play gives a max win of 2,015x, a relatively low cap that keeps the game less extreme than many modern releases. The RTP is 96.46%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
